narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Each prime is written only once!
<bookmark mark='check'/>But two times three times five is only thirty, and not the number on the tag.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>That is far less than the total, so primes must be repeated.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 2, 3 and 5 written once each; the bubble multiplies them to 30 and shows that the tag says 1200; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='sum'/>Divide by primes until the last number is prime, and keep every repeat when you collect.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Use the division method to break nine hundred into primes, repeats included.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the line keep every repeat appears; then a new number, 900, appears with an empty column
